item.tib: nye lam sde bzhi'i smad chog sgo dbye dbang bskur smon lam dngos grub rdzogs rim dbyings su bskyed pa bzhi brtan bkra shis bcas
item.coloph: dbyil bon khyung rgod kyi/ gshen rab zhal bzhugs dus kyi gter/ ti tse gangs la dngos grub brnyes/ ma pang mtsho 'gram zhal kyang bshus/ shog ser kha dras nyi shu la/ nye lam sde bzhi'i bcos mdo 'di yi zhal kyang bshus/ 'gro don rgya lag phyed par shog hri pa la thogs med kyis zhus/ thogs med phyag rgya bris/ dbal gyi bdag gi zhal bshus te/ 'bru bsdus cung zad dag bkrol nas dag par bris pa'o//
